name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Classic Italian pasta dish with a rich and savory meat sauce.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large pan, sauté onions and garlic until translucent.
Add ground beef and cook until browned.
Stir in tomatoes, tomato paste, and seasonings; simmer for 30 minutes.
Serve sauce over cooked pasta and garnish with Parmesan cheese.

name: Chicken Alfredo
description: Creamy Alfredo pasta with tender chicken, perfect comfort food.
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions.
Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper, then cook until golden and cooked through.
In a pan, heat cream and butter, then add Parmesan cheese to make Alfredo sauce.
Toss pasta and chicken in the sauce and serve warm.

name: Beef Tacos
description: Flavorful beef tacos with cheese and your favorite toppings.
instructions: Cook beef in a skillet until browned; season with taco seasoning.
Warm taco shells in the oven or skillet.
Assemble tacos with beef, cheese, lettuce, and salsa.
Serve immediately.

name: Sushi Roll
description: Fresh sushi rolls made with seasoned rice and fresh salmon.
instructions: Cook sushi rice and season with rice vinegar, sugar, and salt.
Place a sheet of seaweed on a bamboo mat.
Spread rice evenly, add salmon and other fillings.
Roll tightly using the mat and slice into pieces.
Serve with soy sauce, wasabi, and pickled ginger.

name: Avocado Toast
description: Simple and healthy avocado toast with a poached egg on top.
instructions: Toast bread slices until golden.
Mash avocado with a pinch of salt and spread on toast.
Top with a poached or fried egg.
Sprinkle with pepper, chili flakes, or everything bagel seasoning.

name: Greek Salad
description: Refreshing Greek salad with crisp vegetables and tangy feta.
instructions: Chop lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, and red onion.
Add olives and feta cheese.
Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, salt, and pepper.
Toss gently and serve chilled.
